artifact.kind: local actual NeoForm source+compiled SDK; complete Minecraft sources are not distributed

facts: get(factory,name) reads once when the name has not been cached; its cache can contain null.
readSavedData catches Exception from both disk parsing and the supplied deserializer, logs the failure and returns null. Loader exceptions alone cannot protect the original file.
computeIfAbsent cannot distinguish an absent journal from a failed read: after null it constructs and installs a new SavedData object.
set(name,data) replaces the cached entry but does not itself dirty the object. save() forwards each non-null cached entry to SavedData.save(file,registries).
Guard policy must distinguish a genuinely absent file from an existing unreadable file before installing any empty record.
scope: API/lifecycle facts and exact upstream source hashes; no full proprietary Minecraft source. Runtime/native assertions are recorded separately.
